main_text.p: [?]لها يام بشر هذه الاوان وجدت انقطاع ابهري من الاكاة التي اكلت مع ابنك [?]خبير Donec in illum, qui mortis ipsi causa fuit, dolorem incidit; quo tempore matrem Baslrari quae eum visendi gratiâ venerat, sic affatus est, Heus mater Bashari, Hâc vice sensi cordis mei venas perruptas vi buccellae carnis ipsius quam una cum filio tuo comedi in Chaibar. Interrogaram autem puellam quare hoc faceret, respondisse ferunt [?]قلت ان كان ملكا استرحنا منه وان كان نبيا فيسخبر AlKodai & AlJannab. Dixi, si Rex fuerit, ab ejus tyrannide liberabimur; sin Propheta fuerit, facilè hoc perceptu-rus est.

p.17.l.15. Ut frequenter facta prodantur, sed ut semel patrata recenseantur ] [?]التواتر ( explicare Alkassaie in libro [?]الخبر الثابت على السنة قوم لا يتصور Taarifat) est المتواتر منها ليس لمعرفة راوده حاجة Ep. Nawayi * v. in متواتر Narratio constanter tradita ab hominibus quos nemo suspicetur in mendacium conspiraturos. scil. * [?]لكثرتهم (ut idem alibi loquitur) ob multitudinem eorum, atque opponit AlGazali [?]احان quae semel accidunt, iis quae saepius facta memorantur, vel plures testes habent; in cap: de miraculis à Mohammede patratis, de quibus quamvis prioris sint generis, minimè dubitandum concendit, cùm [?]مجموع الوقايع تورث علما ضروريا Plura huiusmodi in unum collecta scientiam pariat necessariam.
Innituntur magis uni Alcorano, in quo hoc pro miraculo habent ] AlGazali, [?]هو المعجزة الكبرى الباقية [?]يبين

page.notes: Arabic text is set in a different typeface and is only partly legible on the scan; the marked [?] words are doubtful readings, especially in the first Arabic line, the Arabic inside the Latin lines, and the Arabic margin glosses. The margin gloss "المتواتر منها ليس لمعرفة راوده حاجة" is reconstructed from fragments. The Latin "perceptu-rus" hyphen is kept as printed at the line end. Asterisks are printed reference marks. No catchword or signature is printed.
